title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
I am working with a thriving national business based in Burnley who are now looking to appoint an experienced Accounts Assistant to join their team on a permanent and full-time basis. This is a newly created position which has been created due to continued growth within the business.

Your new role
As Accounts Assistant, you will manage the cashbook, petty cash and reconcile company bank accounts. You will process and deal with all debtors and creditors, ensuring transactions are valid and reconciled, maintain the company's fixed asset register, processing prepayments, accruals, VAT, supplier reconciliations and bank reconciliations. You will be reporting directly to the Finance Manager, where you will gain further exposure to management accounting. This is a full-time role, working Monday to Friday and fully based on-site.

What you'll need to succeed
To be successful in this position, you will have worked in a similar position recently and be able to hit the ground running. You must be incredibly organised, be able to manage your own workload with a self-starter attitude and be confident picking up new systems. Excel skills, including VLOOKUP's and pivot tables are essential for this role, and ideally have worked on SAP or another ERP system.

What you'll get in return
In return for this, you will be offered a full-time salary between £30,000 - £35,000 per annum. Alongside this, you are offered a range of benefits including:
- 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays
- Healthcare cashplan
- Early Friday finish

- Death in service
- Your birthday off

title: Credit Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
I am delighted to be working with an established and growing business based in Blackburn, who are looking to recruit an experienced Credit Controller to join their finance team. This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy finance function in a varied role, working closely with both the wider finance team and other departments across the business.

Your new role
In your new role as Credit Controller, you will take responsibility for maintaining accurate customer ledgers and supporting the effective day-to-day running of the sales ledger and credit control function.
Your responsibilities will include processing daily payments, producing credits and invoices, reconciling merchant statements and monitoring transactions to ensure sales and refunds across B2 C channels are accurately captured. You will also issue month-end statements to credit customers, complete credit card reconciliations and ensure accounts remain up to date and accurate. Alongside this, you will carry out credit checks and due diligence on new accounts, monitor accounts in line with the company's credit insurance policy and identify higher-risk or slow-paying customers for escalation. You will work closely with the sales and customer service teams to resolve invoicing and account queries efficiently.

What you'll need to succeed
You will be a motivated and proactive individual who is comfortable taking ownership of your workload within a busy finance environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are important, as you'll regularly liaise with colleagues across different departments. You'll also need excellent attention to detail, the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, and confidence using Microsoft applications. Experience working with strong financial controls and processes would also be beneficial, particularly within a fast-paced transactional finance environment.

What you'll get in return
In return for this, you will be offered a competitive salary up to £33,000 alongside a healthcare plan, on-site gym, staff discounts on products, Cycle to Work scheme, company pension and free on-site parking. You'll receive 22 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 23 days after three years' service, alongside a 30-minute lunch break.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will be joining an established and busy manufacturing business in Blackburn, that is looking to appoint an experienced Finance Assistant to support its day-to-day accounting processes. This is a varied position offering additional exposure to purchasing, supplier management and internal project coordination.

Your new role
In your new role as Finance Assistant, you will provide hands-on support across the finance function. Your responsibilities will include assisting with sales ledger and purchase ledger activities, maintaining accurate financial records, carrying out credit control and supporting routine reporting and month-end tasks. You will also provide holiday and absence cover for the Finance Administrator, helping to ensure continuity across the department's core processes.
Alongside your finance responsibilities, you will support purchasing activities across the business. This will include coordinating stock requirements, liaising with suppliers, negotiating prices and commercial terms, monitoring supplier performance and identifying opportunities to improve costs and purchasing efficiency. You will also assist with maintaining stock accuracy and planning stock takes.
The role will additionally involve supporting cross-departmental projects by organising project plans, tracking actions and timelines, liaising with colleagues and external partners, and highlighting any risks, opportunities or issues requiring management input.

What you'll need to succeed
You will have practical experience in a varied finance or accounts position, with a good understanding of purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and general accounting processes. You will be organised, proactive and confident managing several responsibilities at once. Strong communication skills are essential, as you will work with colleagues across different departments as well as external suppliers. Previous purchasing, stock-control or supplier-management experience would be advantageous, although the ability to demonstrate sound commercial judgement and a willingness to take on broader responsibilities will be equally important.

What you'll get in return
You will receive a salary up to £32,000, depending on experience, alongside a varied role offering exposure across finance, purchasing and wider business projects. Benefits include 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 26 days after five years' service, with further increases linked to long service. You will also have the option to take your birthday off when it falls on a weekday, access to a healthcare scheme, some flexibility around your agreed working hours and an early finish every Friday.

title: Invoicing & Finance Assistant
description:
Blackburn £28,000-£29,-Month Fixed-Term Contract

Looking for your next step in finance? This could be right up your street!

We're working with a growing business in Blackburn that is looking to strengthen its finance team with a Finance Assistant on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

This is a hands-on, invoice-heavy role, ideal for someone who enjoys working methodically, keeping on top of the detail and making sure things run as they should.

You'll initially focus on a high volume of sales invoicing, credit notes and amendments, with responsibility for keeping processes running smoothly and dealing with queries along the way. There's also scope to get involved in other areas of transactional finance as you settle into the role.

The business is looking for someone with the right attitude and aptitude. You don't need to know everything from day one, but you'll need to be organised, accurate and keen to learn.

What will you be doing?
- Sales invoicing: Raising a high volume of sales invoices, credit notes and amendments using the company's bespoke invoicing system.
- Invoice processing: Monitoring the invoicing process to ensure transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.
- Query management: Liaising with franchisees and responding to invoice queries, resolving issues in a timely and professional manner.
- Purchase ledger: Processing supplier invoices across multiple companies and reconciling supplier statements.
- Supplier payments: Preparing payment runs and ensuring suppliers are paid within the required deadlines.
- Banking: Posting receipts and payments onto Sage 200.
- Financial administration: Maintaining accurate records, keeping files and documentation up to date, and ensuring information is appropriately filed and scanned.
- Team support: Assisting with general finance duties and providing support to colleagues across the business.
- Compliance: Learning and following the relevant financial regulations, policies and procedures.

The role will initially be heavily focused on invoicing and established processes, with the opportunity to broaden your responsibilities as you become confident in the role.

What are we looking for?

We're keen to hear from people who have some experience in a finance or accounts environment and enjoy getting stuck into the day-to-day detail.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within a finance or accounts department.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of transactions.
- Confidence working with systems and processing financial information.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office. Sage 200 experience would be beneficial but isn't essential.
- The ability to manage your own workload and meet deadlines.
- A friendly, approachable manner and good communication skills.
- A flexible, team-focused attitude and a willingness to learn.

You'll be joining a busy team with strong personalities, so being personable, adaptable and confident enough to speak up when needed will be important.

Above all, attitude is key. If you're reliable, methodical and hungry to develop your finance skills, this could be a great opportunity.

What's on offer?
- £28,000-£29,000 salary.
- 12-month fixed-term contract.
- 25 days' annual leave.
- Healthcare plan.
- A lovely office environment in Blackburn.
- A sociable team with regular socials and opportunities to celebrate birthdays and milestones.

Interested?

If you've got some finance experience, enjoy a process-driven role and take pride in getting the detail right, we'd love to hear from you.

Get in touch with Cummins Mellor for a confidential chat or apply today!

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger / Accounts Assistant

Location: Blackburn (BB1)

Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday (Office-based)

Work Location: In person

Full Time / Permanent

Remarkable Jobs are recruiting on behalf of a rapidly growing client in the property and retail space management sector. This pioneering organisation is at the forefront of coordinating and delivering innovative building services across a large portfolio of commercial properties nationwide.

We are seeking a Purchase Ledger / Accounts Assistant with specific experience in managing Business Rates to join their finance team in Blackburn. This is a pivotal role within the company's finance operations, and it offers excellent long-term career potential as the business continues to expand.

Purchase Ledger / Accounts Assistant - Role Focus:

You will be responsible for managing and processing high volumes of property-related supplier invoices, with particular focus on business rates across a national commercial property portfolio. You'll liaise with local authorities, handle rates exemptions, process payments, and ensure accuracy and compliance at every step.

Key Responsibilities:

Process and reconcile business rates invoices across a multi-site commercial property portfolio

Liaise with local councils to manage exemptions, reliefs, and disputes

Maintain supplier ledgers and ensure timely payments using Sage 50

Support budget forecasting and reporting on business rates liabilities

Assist in preparing month-end reports and internal reconciliations

Communicate with property, legal and facilities teams to ensure accuracy of charges

Maintain a strong audit trail and support year-end financial processes

Provide ad hoc support across the wider finance team

What They Are Looking For:

Essential:

3+ years of experience in purchase ledger or accounts payable

Demonstrated experience working with Business Rates in a commercial property setting

Strong knowledge of Sage 50 and Microsoft Excel

High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple property accounts

Confident liaising with local authorities and external stakeholders

Desirable:

Experience in the property, retail, or facilities management sectors

Knowledge of UK business rates legislation and relief options

Key Attributes:

Organised, methodical, and commercially aware

Strong communication skills and a proactive problem-solver

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Benefits Include:

Company bonus scheme

Pension plan

Free on-site parking

Clear progression opportunities within a growing business

Office-based role, Monday to Friday (no weekends)

If you have a background in accounts and a solid understanding of business rates, this is a brilliant opportunity to join a fast-growing team making a real impact in the property sector.

Apply now!
